body:
Yes. Band of Gods or other items can boost gold income. When your high tier can you wear multiple goes multipliera which add up fast but for most players it is not a limiting factor.

Moving 1 gem from a piece  equipment ends up being 300 million just to use up gold.

Getting to tier 10 it might take you a week to save up but that is normal. Band of god gives you a 50% gold boost, then lucky coin, then questing items, all these multipliers add up to you getting 200-300% more kill per monster. Add in sliding rewards in endless and that is a lot

author: Allalilacias
body:
Three days ago I spent 20B changing adornments from one weapon to another. It left me at 49B. Yesterday, out of boredom and to try and score some rift gear, I did 5 endless dungeons. It took me no longer than an hour. I am currently sitting at 54B.

It might sound like little, but, while I don't anymore, I used to do 10-20 endless dungeons per day back when I was trying to become T11. My orn/gold/exp earning ratio plateaued more than a year ago at around level 230, after that it was just a matter of repetition.

So yeah, provided you keep playing and make an effort, you'll definitely have this amount of money.

I will admit, tho, Transference III, Ward of Ortanite and the elemental V spells are exceedingly expensive. I believe TransIII is the cheapest one of the bunch, actually 😅
